svg.title: SolutionState memory layout, archive policy, and snapshot contract
svg.desc: Detailed diagram of SolutionState internal structure showing array dimensions, chunked growth strategy, memory modes, and what the SolutionSnapshot delivers to the postprocessor

g.text: SolutionState (handle class) — single owner: the active solver

svg.text: U_Hist: [nDofs × capacity] chunked pre-alloc (±50 cols at a time)
LambdaHist / ArcLengthHist: [1 × capacity] — same chunked policy
PlasticHistoryArchive: {capacity × 1} cell — ONLY allocated if Material.Type == J2Plastic
Archive memory policy — set in SolverOptions.MemoryMode
appendStep(U, lambda, plasticSnap, reaction, ds) — the single write gate
2. Grow chunk arrays if StepCount > capacity (add 50 cols, never double entire array)
3. Write U_Hist(:, StepCount) = U (no copy — in-place column assignment)
4. If plasticSnap not empty: deep copy struct array into PlasticArchive{StepCount}
Shares reference: PlasticHistoryArchive cell (read-only, no copy — large data)
Shares reference: ElementCache (for GP shape functions, read-only)
Postprocessor may not call appendStep or commitHistory — snapshot has no such methods
Invariant: StepCount <= size(U_Hist,2) at all times
Columns beyond StepCount are pre-allocated zeros, never exposed outside SolutionState
